title: Guarded auto-merge for refresh PRs, on required checks
goal: A refresh PR that changes only generated files merges itself on green CI and deletes its branch
acceptance: main requires the CI check check (PR required, 0 approvals, admins included, no force-push or deletion); allow_auto_merge on; Actions-can-approve off
The refresh workflow enables auto-merge with --delete-branch only when tools/refresh-guard.mjs passes; otherwise it comments why and leaves auto-merge off
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
validation: check:fast; npm test; final applicable CI
escalation: Repository settings are the owner's: ask before changing them
Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one workflow step, a small guard tool with tests, two settings calls. Not a measurement. Verified 2026-11-25: owner applied branch protection (required check `check`) and allow_auto_merge; PR #31 merged on green (merge-when-green); dispatched refresh run 45624037674 ran the guard ("ok") and enabled auto-merge on PR #32, which merged itself at 13:30:19Z after `check` passed.
